records.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production pixel-art RPG attack sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is the sole exact character identity, costume, palette and rendering reference, NOT a background reference.
Create ONE square 2048x2048 PNG sheet with a true transparent alpha background. Exactly SIX full-body sprites, equally spaced in THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. No cell borders, no grid, no text, no labels, no numbers, no backdrop, no shadow plane, no checkerboard pixels. Each invisible cell is 682x1024 approximately. Keep each sprite entirely within its own cell, with generous empty space around all hair and limbs. Feet lie on the same baseline in each row, pelvis horizontal anchor remains at each cell center. Match body scale across all six frames; fully show hair and all boots/feet. 
Subject: Lucky Burns, an adult fictional muscular female RPG fighter. Preserve EXACTLY the supplied reference's adult face, blue eyes, long flowing golden blonde hair, powerful large muscles, body proportions, skin tone, costume, colors, every accessory and footwear. Preserve reference costume coverage without changing clothing. No new clothing, no invented accessories, no weapons.
Style: meticulous, crisp, high-detail pixel-art game illustration matching input reference, strong pixel-defined contour and densely shaded muscles and materials. Maintain one stable character model, facial identity and outfit across every frame.
Six chronological attack frames: (1) ready stance resembling reference, one hand raised and one lowered, oriented three-quarter toward screen right; (2) clear anticipation, both fists come to combat guard with weight pulled back; (3) decisive forward straight punch toward screen right with one arm strongly extended, torso rotates; (4) punch follow-through with weight forward and flowing hair responding naturally; (5) recovery retracting fist to guard; (6) return to exactly frame 1's stance for a seamless loop. Athletic nonsexual combat action. No opponents, no contact, no blood. No flashing effects or motion trails that obscure anatomy. Never duplicate a pose in intermediate frames.
Specific outfit invariants: black leather red-lined jacket draped around arms, black buckled combat two-piece with red crown emblems, black gloves, gold square buckles, black thigh straps, red hip sash with white crown, heavy black platform lace-up boots with red laces and buckles.
concerns: Background checkerboard is baked into RGB pixels; not usable as a transparent animation sheet.
Frame 4 extends a little beyond its equal cell's right boundary.
Dimensions returned by tool are 1254 x 1254 despite 2048 x 2048 requested.
